$comment: Components' own answers for the managed quality gates (see .cratis/ai/hooks/scripts/quality-gates.json).
The repository root is a Yarn workspace aggregator without g:compile, g:compile:specs, or lint:ci;
the published package lives in Source/.
frontend-compile type-checks Source without emitting, the same check Source's compile script runs,
but without generate-parts or lint --fix, so the gate never rewrites files.
frontend-compile-specs has no counterpart: specs (for_*) are excluded from every tsconfig and are
type-stripped by Vitest, so frontend-specs is their check. The gate matches no change, so it never runs.

gates.description: Source: yarn lint:ci — zero ESLint errors
Source: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit — zero TypeScript errors
Not applicable: specs are type-stripped by Vitest and checked by frontend-specs
